reviewed_by: Claude (curator, acting for Gottfried Schmidtke on his request)
summary: USG Input Reading: a source adapter in front of USG that reads complex existing sources (models, drawing sets, scans) into addressable evidence records. Three partition fields (world_relation, participation_role, design_authority_relation), ordered authority resolution with an invalid default, tiered equivalence proof before prototype compression, mirror handedness review, a Reading Grid only where complexity remains, materiality-driven questions, reading acceptance checks RA-01 to RA-13, and two proposed fixtures (IR-CC-01, IR-CC-02).
affected_areas: evidence and authority (docs/proposals/evidence-class-mapping.md, v0.12 answer_authority, evidence_model)
possible future adapter fields in schema/usg-output.schema.json
rationale: It is the source adapter the source-neutral handoff proposal anticipates and keeps outside the stage model, so it needs no stage change. It reuses v0.12 authority, claim-status and confidence semantics and extends the evidence-class mapping to existing-world and external-design sources, which is normative and depends on the owner's decision on that mapping. It has been through five review rounds with a full decision log, but no fixture or real source has been run, so it stays a proposal.
provenance: Drafted by Gottfried Schmidtke; v0.1 to v0.3.4 on 2026-10-27, revised after reviews by Claude (CLA, CL2-CL4), Mistral (MIS, MIS3) and ChatGPT/Zara (ZAR); every adoption and rejection is in the archived decision log
Supplied by the owner directly to the curator (not through inbox/); the package is archived as received
Originating case: a SketchUp masterplan of a large healthcare campus, anonymized at v0.2
tests_performed: Duplicate check against v0.12, docs/proposals/*, docs/handoff-to-arpl.md: no existing adapter contract; consistent with the source-neutral proposal's stage placement
Authority check against v0.12 answer_authority and site_fact_rule: existing-world human statements are external_evidence/owner_statement, max medium (consistent since v0.3.4)

Rule coverage walk of authority_resolution under first_match_wins: found C-01 (scan/imagery/terrain/imported_reference origins without a rule), C-02 (designer's own approximate annotation without a rule), C-03 (one unreachable rule)
Internal consistency: no stale source_role/authority_mapping terms; one conformance_candidates list; one claim_link; duplicate open questions noted (C-04)
tools/check_contracts.py, tools/check_usg.py, tools/build_stages.py --check, tests/test_runner.py and the pinned conformance instances run after adding the record (results in LOG-0013)
